summary: Enthusiastic and hardworking nursing school graduate. Graduated Salutatorian and Magna Cum Laude from Chamberlain University. My can-do attitude has led me to be a valued member to all my prior employers.

description: Interviewed patients, measured vital signs, and documented all information on patients' EMR.
Assisted nurses in pre-and postoperative therapy with treatments; inserting and discontinuing Foley catheter, discontinuing IV catheters, and maintaining IV fluids.
Collected and prepared laboratory specimens, preformed glucose monitoring.
Transported patients via wheel chairs and stretcher, assisted patients to ambulate around the unit. Notified nurses of any conditional changes of patients in my care.
Provided care and comfort to all patients, ensuring the best possible care.
Assisted patrons during selection of food and beverages by presenting menu, and offering recommendations.
Transmitted orders to bar and kitchen by recording patrons' choices; identified patrons' special dietary needs and special requests.
Protected establishment and patrons by adhering to sanitation, safety, and alcohol beverage control policies.
Drastically reduced aircraft discrepancies by 30% during my tenure with Patrol Squadron Sixteen.

Troubleshot, replaced, and repaired critical electronic equipment on 17 different P-3C aircraft avionic systems. Responsible for accurate and timely updating of aircraft log books. Accountable for over 10 junior sailors in my work center.
Assisted DVM with medical examinations, triaged incoming patients and managed clients throughout their visit.
Prepared animals for surgery, prepared surgical packs, monitored patients under anesthesia, and assisted Veterinarians during surgical procedures.
Performed dental procedures, x-rays, lab and bloodwork.
Gave vaccinations, obtained blood samples, and administered medications. Monitored and appropriately documented patient vital signs and activity.
Clearly communicated instructions to my clients and veterinary assistants.

certifications.name: American Heart Association Basic Life Support (BLS) Certification

matchmaking_summary: The candidate stands out for their dedication and the strong advocate role they play within healthcare settings. Graduating Salutatorian and Magna Cum Laude from Chamberlain University highlights a commitment to academic excellence, which is pivotal in nursing. Their experience as a Patient Care Technician demonstrates hands-on skills in patient care and interacting with medical teams, crucial in ensuring both patient well-being and smooth hospital operations.
